# RentalOS
> White-label luxury rental booking SaaS.
> Built for car rental, yacht, villa, and motorcycle rental businesses.

## What it does
- Complete booking system: inquiry → confirm → pickup → return
- Mobile-first admin panel for managing bookings and fleet
- Email notifications (customer confirmation + admin alerts)
- Transfer/delivery fee management
- Document upload at pickup (licence, passport)
- Rate limiting and security hardened

## Tech stack
- Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript
- Supabase (database, auth, storage)
- Resend (transactional email)
- Vercel (hosting)
- Stripe (subscription billing, optional)

## Business model
- Template sale: €299 one-time
- SaaS subscription: €99–299/month
- Done-for-you setup: €499 one-time
